maker: Robbyant (Shanghai Ant Robbyant Technology Co., Ltd., Ant Group)
name: Robbyant R2
summary: A wheeled dual-arm humanoid from Ant Group's robotics unit for indoor retail, home and light industrial tasks, rated 6 kg per arm with about 4 h runtime on swappable batteries.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller or distributor for R2 found. Robbyant showed the earlier R1 at IFA 2025 in Berlin and said it works with partners in the DACH region and Europe, but no R2 sales route is named; the maker lists only Chinese sales contacts.

specs.label: Weight
specs.quote: A lightweight body under 120 kg and 6 kg rated payload per arm balance agility and strength.

specs.label: Rated payload per arm
specs.conditions: rated; Yanko Design quotes up to 5 kg per arm
specs.quote: A lightweight body under 120 kg and 6 kg rated payload per arm balance agility and strength.

specs.label: Reach height
specs.quote: From the floor to two meters high, shelves are within reach.

specs.label: Runtime
specs.conditions: about 4 h, swappable dual batteries, optional dock charging
specs.quote: Swappable dual batteries deliver around 4 hours of runtime, with optional dock charging for automatic recharge during idle time.

specs.label: Base width
specs.quote: Built on a 455 mm rectangular base with a body width equal to human shoulder span, it can navigate 650mm aisles smoothly

specs.label: DOF per arm
specs.quote: Dual arms with seven degrees of freedom, each capable of lifting up to 5kg

specs.label: Safety features
specs.value: joint torque feedback, six-axis force sensing at the end effector, joint brakes on e-stop
specs.quote: Joint torque feedback, six‑axis force sensing at the end effector, compliant grasping, and precise placement. Core joint brakes lock on emergency stop for immediate safety.

notes: Omnidirectional steering-wheel chassis built for indoor aisles; the maker calls it a platform for real indoor scenarios.
Robbyant lists dexterous hands, grippers, suction cups and custom end tools for its robot platforms; which tool ships with R2 is not stated.
Lifecycle set to pilot_only because the maker says R2 'works with robot foundation models and scenario solutions for validation in real indoor tasks'; no delivery or order figures were found.

evidence.task: Indoor retail and home service: sorting stock and moving items between shelves
evidence.note: No construction or site use reported.

sources.title: Humanoid Robots Don't Fit in Store Aisles, So Robbyant Fixed That
